svg.title: Three modes, one entry
svg.desc: Discuss You have an idea Features first, build second → feature map + plan / Review You have a project Both read it, then cross-check → gap list + top 3 fixes / Dispatch You have a plan Split, assign, verify → a done report with evidence — Type /roadstar (or 用 skill): it picks the mode, prints one setup line, and starts.
